mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (email, password_hash, nickname) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM members ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM members WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE members SET email = CONCAT('deleted_', id, '@withdrawn'), nickname = CONCAT('탈퇴회원', id), password_hash = '' WHERE id = #{id}
